test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only three people are sitting between R and O when counted from the left of R. Only M is sitting between L and N. N is an immediate neighbour of O. P is sitting third to the right of L.

Who is sitting second to the left of O?
solution:
Given, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Only three people are sitting between R and O when counted from the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/109bd1157a81b8370ba151b185e93ebd92160d9d6adf71f86a6e48db1b33b4a1.png] 

Only M is sitting between L and N.

N is an immediate neighbour of O.

P is sitting third to the right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bae1dde48a661b6b82b83d2b4e8a114a0c3a8389f5100dd00f8c87f397420d68.png] 

And Q sit at remaining place. 

Possible seating arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09d5c50b55bba49e0bd092d460b3df64d300d0279457a67d157815b2650472e2.png] 

Q is sitting second to the left of O

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
